verdict.rationale: Data residency is a fair question for a SaaS observability platform, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents a way to choose a storage region or data-residency location. Community posts only discuss latency for non-US users and demand for on-prem hosting, which does not show a region-selection capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
